summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL10, mariadb-server-galera 10.11.18) with firewall ports (3306/4567/4568/4444) and SELinux boolean mysql_connect_any opened for wsrep traffic. Bootstrapped on node1 via galera_new_cluster, joined node2 and node3 via rsync SST. Verified writes issued on any member replicate synchronously to the other two (multi-master). Tested availability during a single-member outage (stopped node2, wrote successfully from node1 and node3 with cluster_status=Primary at size 2) and automatic resynchronization when node2 rejoined (auto SST, back to size 3/Synced with all rows intact). Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id + cluster health baseline on each node, restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled each until reachable, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed each node returned to mariadb active / wsrep_cluster_size=3 / Synced / Primary with full data present before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera, rsync on node1/node2/node3
Appended CLUSTER_HOSTS to /etc/hosts on all nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306/tcp,4567/tcp,4567/udp,4568/tcp,4444/tcp on all nodes
Set SELinux boolean mysql_connect_any=on (persistent) on all nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/z-galera-cluster.cnf per-node with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3, unique wsrep_node_name/address, wsrep_sst_method=rsync
Bootstrapped cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster; enabled mariadb
Started/enabled mariadb on node2 and node3, which joined via SST
Generated root and appuser passwords on node1 (python3 secrets), set root password via ALTER USER, created galera_test DB and appuser grants (replicated cluster-wide)
Distributed credential files to node2/node3 via scp using cluster SSH key
Verified cross-node write visibility: inserted rows from node1, node2, node3 and confirmed all visible from every node
Simulated node2 outage: stopped mariadb on node2, wrote from node1 and node3, confirmed cluster stayed Primary at size 2
Restarted node2, confirmed automatic SST rejoin and cluster back to size 3/Synced with outage-period writes present

Executed mandatory restart protocol on node1, node2, node3 sequentially: captured boot_id + wsrep health baseline, systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed mariadb active + wsrep_cluster_size=3 + Synced + Primary + data intact before moving to next node

evidence.requirement: 3-node Galera cluster formed, writes from any member visible to others
evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped and all 3 nodes joined at wsrep_cluster_size=3/Synced; inserts from node1, node2, and node3 each become visible on all three nodes

evidence.requirement: Availability maintained when one member is down
evidence.summary: With node2 stopped, cluster stayed wsrep_cluster_status=Primary at size 2 and accepted new writes from node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: Automatic resynchronization of a returning member
evidence.summary: node2 restarted, automatically performed SST, rejoined at cluster_size=3/Synced with all rows written during its outage present

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
